mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% month-over-month growth indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * CPIAUCSL) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in < 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) signals economic weakness that triggers recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and INDPRO < 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1450.0 thousand units indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1450.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals robust manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (INDPRO > 105.0 for 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) drives equity returns: when both exceed their 3-month moving averages, it indicates a synchronized housing market expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS growth * HOUST growth) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rapid payroll growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.8% MoM) signals excessive labor demand that triggers wage inflation and central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.8% MoM.
